Reason for Mistake: Despite the Planner’s explicit instruction to collect citable quotes (including seasonality/Las Vegas context), WebSurfer repeated the same “site:weather.gov ‘Flash Flood Warning’ definition” search and reported only search-result snippets without clicking through, extracting exact quotes, or addressing the seasonal/irregular occurrence aspect.
